scope: Offline source/schema/evidence audit only; no product edits, runtime execution, provider/model/search/daemon calls, private workpad access, package installation, or release claim.
authority_rule: Journal and authenticated committed artifact bytes are authoritative; SQLite, report, HTML, and selector outputs are derived views.

command_receipts.result: Read supplied-row input, progress, status, resume, digest, and refusal paths.

command_receipts.command: rtk proxy nl -ba src/gigai/scout_discovery_job.py | sed -n '1,205p'; rtk proxy nl -ba src/gigai/scout_posting_inputs.py | sed -n '341,500p'
command_receipts.result: Read transient public import and completed-Run posting authority paths.
Read local assessment source selection, terminal result, and failure paths.
Read explicit event schema vocabulary, writer, replay/correction, and history reader.
Read S09 privacy, storage, freshness, ToS, and measured-trial limits; no live call made.

rows.behavior: Persist a bounded caller-supplied public row batch with exact input bytes and public-only fields.
rows.consumer: read_public_acquisition_status, resume_public_acquisition, acquisition CLI
rows.input_shape: JSON array of at most 512 objects with opportunity_id, snapshot_id, public fields, optional source_snapshot.
rows.output_shape: scout-public-import-input:1 artifact and content_sha256 ref.
rows.revision_and_provenance: Canonical input bytes are digest-bound; project_id and gig_id are embedded and scope-checked.
rows.failure_and_recovery: Rejects unknown/private fields, malformed rows, unsafe source files, scope mismatch, or changed input for an existing batch.
rows.view_or_authority: Journal input artifact is authority; no provider/search is performed.
rows.disposition: Retain as the persistence handoff; do not turn this operation into a fetcher.

rows.behavior: Classify duplicate, failure, exclusion, and accepted public rows.
rows.consumer: progress status DTO and report-independent acquisition readers
rows.input_shape: Validated row plus an identity set of opportunity_id/snapshot_id.
rows.output_shape: considered, duplicate, failure, or exclusion outcome with index and reason.
rows.revision_and_provenance: Outcome index is tied to the exact input digest and progress revision.
rows.failure_and_recovery: Duplicate is visible; row error/failed and excluded are retained rather than hidden; restart reuses prior outcomes.
rows.view_or_authority: Progress artifact is authoritative for this import batch.
rows.disposition: Existing bounded behavior; later connector dedup must map into it or define a separate versioned source contract.

rows.behavior: Persist cumulative progress, deadline, stop reason, and fresh-process status.
rows.consumer: read_public_acquisition_status, status/resume CLI callers
rows.input_shape: Validated input digest, parent revision/head, processed prefix, outcome arrays, deadline.
rows.output_shape: scout-public-import-progress:1 with parent_progress_revision and parent_journal_head.
rows.revision_and_provenance: CAS-like one-root/one-tip chain and exact input digest; status returns journal_head.
rows.failure_and_recovery: Refuses missing/forked progress, bad parent, tampered working bytes, malformed schema, or non-prefix indexes.
rows.view_or_authority: Committed input/progress artifacts are authority; DTO is a reader result.
rows.disposition: Existing; later projection must consume this without weakening its chain checks.

rows.behavior: Resume a partial batch and replay a complete batch idempotently.
rows.consumer: resume CLI and direct service caller
rows.input_shape: Existing batch_id, optional caller rows, deadline; no rows means exact committed input.
rows.output_shape: New cumulative progress revision or existing complete status.
rows.revision_and_provenance: Parent progress revision/head and input digest are carried forward; changed input conflicts.
rows.failure_and_recovery: Safe refusal on changed input, missing progress, fork, tamper, or journal conflict; complete replay does not append.
rows.view_or_authority: Journal chain is authority.
rows.disposition: Existing bounded recovery; no scheduler/missed-run behavior is established.

rows.behavior: Run external discovery/search/ATS acquisition and schedule it.
rows.producer: No audited producer; current import source explicitly accepts already-acquired rows.
rows.consumer: Future acquisition owner and pending/failure projection; no current provider caller.
rows.input_shape: Future public-only watchlist/general-search settings and source identity; shape not frozen.
rows.output_shape: Must be a versioned source/Run record or existing authenticated posting tuple with bytes/digest/status.
rows.revision_and_provenance: No current connector, scheduler, freshness receipt, or provider request provenance is established in audited sources.
rows.failure_and_recovery: Future contract must distinguish unavailable provider/key, empty result, timeout, duplicate, and restart; not defined here.
rows.view_or_authority: No current authority path; do not infer one from a row or tool description.
rows.disposition: Future connector/scheduler story; preserve public/private query separation and leave freshness/storage/ToS unresolved until authorized proof.

rows.behavior: Resolve one completed discovery posting to exact public capture bytes.
rows.producer: completed discovery Run receipt/checkpoint/domain/capture artifacts via resolve_discovery_posting_input_from_journal
rows.consumer: proposal, Tailor, discovery job, report readers
rows.input_shape: Closed selector family/run_id/receipt_id/output_kind/opportunity_id/snapshot_id.
rows.output_shape: posting bytes plus run_ref, receipt_ref, checkpoint_ref, posting_ref and identity.
rows.revision_and_provenance: Pinned snapshot; exact digest/size refs; one succeeded terminal receipt; same Plan/Run/checkpoint lineage.
rows.failure_and_recovery: Rejects malformed/foreign selector, non-succeeded or multiple terminal receipts, missing capture, bad checks, domain mismatch, or no exact posting.
rows.view_or_authority: Committed discovery packet/capture is authority; resolver is an authenticated reader.
rows.disposition: Existing bounded completed-Run authority; no provider polling implied.

rows.behavior: Show discovery opportunity rows in the report projection.
rows.consumer: default_reader_set, projection, generated report
rows.input_shape: Pinned snapshot containing succeeded receipt, discovery output, authenticated domain sidecar, and posting capture.
rows.output_shape: Opportunity/snapshot/title/employer/source/acquisition_state/provenance row.
rows.revision_and_provenance: Each row resolves posting against the current pinned snapshot; v1 output with no domain sidecar is skipped.
rows.failure_and_recovery: Failed receipt and unauthenticated/malformed sidecar do not become opportunity rows; reader raises on invalid selected authority.
rows.view_or_authority: Derived report row; completed packet/capture remains authority.
rows.disposition: Existing completed-discovery view; does not show supplied-import new/pending/failed rows.

rows.behavior: Select an authenticated posting and explicit private revisions for local assessment.
rows.consumer: local model invocation and proposal result lineage
rows.input_shape: Closed posting selector and tuple of private selectors with explicit purposes.
rows.output_shape: ScoutProposalRequest with public/private source descriptors and lineage_sha256.
rows.revision_and_provenance: Exact selected revision bytes/digests; host lineage and sealed_journal_head; local target digest.
rows.failure_and_recovery: Refuses unavailable/unauthenticated sources, wrong purpose, foreign scope, non-local target, missing local permission, or invalid active Goal.
rows.view_or_authority: Committed posting/private revisions are authority; model sees handles and bytes only during invocation.
rows.disposition: Existing local-only source selection; no hosted fallback or provider lookup.

rows.behavior: Persist and expose assessment execution state independently of user tracking.
rows.producer: proposal execution result and Run/Goal terminal transitions
rows.consumer: proposal result reader, report Run rows, later projection
rows.input_shape: Local invocation attempt/result plus Run/Goal identity.
rows.output_shape: Host result status complete/failed; Goal terminal states complete/failed/blocked/cancelled; report active/waiting_input or receipt outcome.
rows.revision_and_provenance: Invocation record digest, request_sha256, input lineage, sealed head, Goal evidence refs.
rows.failure_and_recovery: Stopped/invalid model result becomes failed evidence and failed Goal; report authenticates result against Goal evidence.
rows.view_or_authority: Run/result artifacts are authority; report/projection are views.
rows.disposition: Freeze a view mapping or retain separate state namespaces; do not claim roadmap new/pending/running/succeeded/skipped is implemented.

rows.behavior: Record an immutable proposal revision with opportunity, inputs, assessment, method, and invocation lineage.
rows.consumer: proposal report rows and Tailor saved-proposal hydration
rows.input_shape: Complete host result plus exact posting/private source selectors and operation key.
rows.output_shape: scout-proposal-revision:1 state active record/revision object.
rows.revision_and_provenance: Complete assessment digest, selected input revision/digests/purposes, invocation IDs/record_sha256, local configured digest, sealed journal head.
rows.failure_and_recovery: Refuses incomplete result, changed source bytes, invalid lineage, malformed strict schema, or conflicting operation/revision identity; identical operation replays.
rows.view_or_authority: Journal proposal revision is authority; report row is derived.
rows.disposition: Existing; freeze whether revisions are sibling immutable identities or need an additive ancestry field.

rows.behavior: Associate selected answer questions with a proposal revision.
rows.consumer: proposal revision schema/report/Tailor selection
rows.input_shape: Answer record/revision, explicit question_ids, purpose answer, content digest.
rows.output_shape: Embedded association lacks schema_version and association_id; standalone schema requires both.
rows.revision_and_provenance: Question IDs and answer revision digest are host-bound; no standalone association identity is emitted by helper.
rows.failure_and_recovery: Malformed IDs/questions/digest refuse proposal record; unanswered native states remain explicit.
rows.view_or_authority: Proposal revision embedding is current record authority; standalone schema is an unused/conflicting contract until freeze.
rows.disposition: Choose embedded authoritative shape or versioned standalone identity; no schema edit in P2-AUD-02.

rows.behavior: Select posting, candidate evidence, answers, optional proposal, and requested document outputs.
rows.consumer: Tailor local invocation and Run sealing
rows.input_shape: Exact opportunity/snapshot, source roles posting/candidate_evidence, requested outputs, explicit answer/proposal selectors.
rows.output_shape: scout-tailor-selection:2 and scout-tailoring-request:1 bytes.
record_paths: sealed Run input / Tailor request artifacts
rows.revision_and_provenance: Exact source content_sha256 and host identities; no automatic best-resume selection.
rows.failure_and_recovery: Refuses missing posting/candidate evidence, duplicate sources/outputs, invalid selectors, or malformed request sections.
rows.view_or_authority: Sealed host selection/request is authority for the Tailor invocation.
rows.disposition: Existing explicit selection; keep selection distinct from application.

rows.behavior: Publish immutable Tailor document revisions with source lineage and exact bytes.
rows.consumer: final selection, report document reader, application document redemption
rows.input_shape: DocumentRevision content/kind/identity plus authenticated Tailor invocation provenance.
rows.output_shape: Document descriptor plus content artifact and content_sha256.
rows.revision_and_provenance: Source lineage, checks, parent_revision_id, Tailor run/goal/invocation/output digest; bytes re-read from committed snapshot.
rows.failure_and_recovery: Identity-to-different-bytes conflicts; malformed or unavailable committed bytes refuse; failed Tailor preserves invocation evidence.
rows.view_or_authority: Journal document descriptor/content are authority.
rows.disposition: Existing; no application side effect.

rows.behavior: Explicitly final-select and read authenticated Tailor documents.
rows.consumer: document CLI/report/application document refs
rows.input_shape: Committed document selectors plus Tailor run/goal/invocation/output digest and operation key.
rows.output_shape: scout-document-selection:1 legacy or :2 source_run-authenticated selection.
rows.revision_and_provenance: Each selected revision is re-read and digest checked; v2 redeems Tailor result/Goal evidence.
rows.failure_and_recovery: Conflicting selection bytes refuse; identical selection bytes replay; malformed/missing docs or Tailor evidence refuse.
rows.view_or_authority: Selection artifact is authority for explicit document choice; report is a view.
rows.disposition: Existing; selection never implies application.

rows.behavior: Record explicit application/tracking event with operator confirmation and exact journal receipt.
rows.consumer: read_application, projection, report
rows.input_shape: Opportunity/event kind/timezone/document refs/notes/supersedes/operation_key; no caller request_evidence.
rows.output_shape: application-event:1 event plus operation receipt.
rows.revision_and_provenance: Direct operator evidence, requested_event_sha256, payload_sha256, operation key, recorded_at, journal sequence.
rows.failure_and_recovery: No-confirm, bad timezone/identity, malformed docs, foreign opportunity, changed retry, identity conflict, correction invalid, or journal conflict refuses without a valid event.
rows.view_or_authority: Event and receipt are journal authority; no outbound application submission occurs.
rows.disposition: Existing direct operator writer; do not make proposal/Tailor a prerequisite.

rows.behavior: Represent roadmap tracking states shortlist/applied/interviewing/rejected/archived/untracked.
rows.consumer: application history/status and report job status
rows.input_shape: Current event_kind enum: saved, applied, interview_scheduled, offer_received, rejected, withdrawn.
rows.output_shape: Current status is latest non-superseded event_kind; report fallback is not recorded.
rows.revision_and_provenance: UTC occurred_at then journal sequence; supersedes removes prior current event; no shortlist/archive state field.
rows.failure_and_recovery: Unsupported roadmap label is rejected by current schema/validator; no direct mapping is established.
rows.view_or_authority: Event enum is authority; report label is derived.
rows.disposition: Choose versioned new enum or explicit view mapping; never silently relabel saved/interview_scheduled.

rows.behavior: Replay identical application operation and record correction/supersession.
rows.consumer: application CLI/projection/report
rows.input_shape: Same operation key and event request/payload bytes, or new same-opportunity event with supersedes.
rows.output_shape: already_recorded, operation conflict, recorded event, or correction refusal/current status.
rows.revision_and_provenance: Receipt binds operation key/request/payload/event; history uses event supersedes and journal sequence.
rows.failure_and_recovery: Changed retry conflicts; missing/wrong target or self-cycle refuses; journal conflict is typed.
rows.view_or_authority: Event/receipt journal authority; current status is derived.
rows.disposition: Existing; freeze whether multiple non-cyclic corrections are intentionally allowed.

rows.behavior: Redeem exact application document and opportunity authority.
rows.consumer: application writer, projection, report
rows.input_shape: Legacy private document refs or closed Scout document refs with opportunity/snapshot/Tailor provenance.
rows.output_shape: Validated event/document links or explicit unresolved opportunity annotation in permissive projection.
rows.revision_and_provenance: Committed document bytes/digest and Tailor result/Goal evidence are checked; opportunity reader can be absent/unresolved.
rows.failure_and_recovery: Missing/mismatched document or strict unresolved opportunity refuses; permissive projection retains unresolved event.
rows.view_or_authority: Journal event/document/opportunity artifacts are authority; unresolved flag is view metadata.
rows.disposition: Retain explicit unresolved behavior; freeze whether release requires strict opportunity redemption.

rows.behavior: Build a journal-derived projection from one pinned snapshot with reader provenance.
rows.consumer: rebuild_projection, in-memory query view, report renderer
rows.input_shape: JournalSnapshot, project/gig, optional reader set; committed private/application/domain readers.
rows.output_shape: scout-projection:1 with journal_head/cursor and opportunities/proposals/questions/documents/evidence/applications/runs.
rows.revision_and_provenance: Snapshot head is cursor; rows are host DTOs; application/proposal links are verified against opportunity rows.
rows.failure_and_recovery: Reader failure/invalid row raises; optional require_opportunity_links refuses unresolved events; default preserves explicit unresolved rows.
rows.view_or_authority: Projection is a derived view over journal authority.
rows.disposition: Existing; keep reader hooks and pinned snapshot as the only cross-lane join boundary.

rows.behavior: Cache/query projection in SQLite without making SQLite authoritative.
rows.consumer: read_cached_projection and report integration
rows.input_shape: ScoutProjection value with journal_head/cursor.
rows.output_shape: Disposable in-memory tables or state.sqlite scout_meta payload.
rows.revision_and_provenance: Cached payload includes schema_version, journal_head, and cursor; rebuild originates from pinned snapshot.
rows.failure_and_recovery: Missing/invalid cache refuses; rebuild recreates cache from authority; no cache write creates journal artifacts.
rows.view_or_authority: SQLite is disposable view only.
rows.disposition: Existing derived cache; no new authoritative table in freeze.

rows.behavior: Generate/read a local HTML report with stale journal-head status and no mutation controls.
rows.consumer: scout-report CLI and copied Gig wrapper; operator browser/UI later
rows.input_shape: Projection plus local template/style; current selector for status.
rows.output_shape: Generated HTML/CSS/report metadata/current selector; stale boolean on read.
rows.revision_and_provenance: Metadata records journal_head/projection_cursor/template/style digests; report links are relative committed paths.
rows.failure_and_recovery: Unsafe/missing source, invalid selector/path, missing target, or publication error refuses; current selector remains atomic.
rows.view_or_authority: HTML/selector are derived views; journal remains authority.
rows.disposition: Existing read-only report; missing roadmap tracking update/pending import UI.

rows.behavior: Expose source-backed operations through direct CLI and copied Scout Gig wrapper.
rows.consumer: operators and later UI/Run integration
rows.input_shape: CLI flags and canonical JSON selectors; direct confirmation for private/event writes.
rows.output_shape: Typed JSON/Click results or journal artifacts depending on operation.
record_paths: Operation-specific paths named by producer rows
rows.revision_and_provenance: Direct CLI uses direct_cli_confirm; copied wrapper uses direct_copied_gig_confirm; selectors remain host-resolved.
rows.failure_and_recovery: Commands return typed errors; copied wrapper has no application parser/dispatch; no application Run caller found in audited source.
rows.view_or_authority: CLI is caller; only journal writers create authority.
rows.disposition: Freeze whether copied wrapper must gain application callers; do not invent a new wrapper API in this audit.

rows.behavior: Construct general-search queries from public approved fields and keep private preferences unavailable to provider path.
rows.producer: No current provider query producer in audited paths; S09 design guidance only.
rows.consumer: Future acquisition connector/scheduler and privacy acceptance lane.
rows.input_shape: Future public search-settings record; private preference record must be structurally unavailable.
rows.output_shape: Provider request provenance and public source capture; not defined in current schemas.
rows.revision_and_provenance: No current provider request, query digest, privacy test, or live acceptance receipt.
rows.failure_and_recovery: Future path must distinguish unavailable provider/key from zero results and preserve ATS watchlist operation; not implemented.
rows.view_or_authority: Design input only; no provider authority path.
rows.disposition: Proposed acceptance contract; no legal conclusion or provider call.

rows.behavior: Establish freshness, durable storage/caching rights, and provider ToS boundaries for discovery.
rows.producer: S09 research/open-question record; no current product producer.
rows.consumer: Future acquisition implementation/release decision.
rows.input_shape: Authorized matched ATS-vs-search freshness experiment and provider documentation review.
rows.output_shape: Documented design disposition and receipts; no current schema.
rows.revision_and_provenance: S09 reports unmeasured indexing latency, unresolved storage rights, and incomplete ToS review; measured addendum is only 3 queries/provider.
rows.failure_and_recovery: No current implementation behavior; later work must keep provider unavailable/empty/error distinct.
rows.view_or_authority: Research/design evidence only; not live/provider acceptance.
rows.disposition: Keep open through freeze; no connector readiness claim.

rows.behavior: Show an acquired posting as pending/failed before or independently of assessment.
rows.producer: Acquisition progress has durable outcomes; no current report reader consumes it as an opportunity row.
rows.consumer: Roadmap tracking/report/UI surface.
rows.input_shape: Supplied import progress or future source Run status plus posting identity.
rows.output_shape: New/pending/failed row independent from proposal state; not currently defined.
rows.revision_and_provenance: Progress is authenticated, but no report row links it to an opportunity/projection cursor.
rows.failure_and_recovery: Progress failures remain visible to acquisition status; dashboard behavior for model-off or pre-assessment cases is not present in audited reader.
rows.view_or_authority: Existing progress artifact is authority; missing is the derived cross-lane view contract.
rows.disposition: Smallest later amendment is a read-only pending/failure DTO/reader; do not alter public/private authority boundary.

rows.behavior: Read a stale report/projection and rebuild from journal authority.
rows.consumer: report CLI and local report generation
rows.input_shape: Current selector with journal_head and authenticated generated report; current journal HEAD.
rows.output_shape: stale boolean or rebuilt projection/report cache with new cursor/head.
rows.revision_and_provenance: Selector/report metadata records journal_head/projection_cursor; rebuild reads one pinned snapshot.
rows.failure_and_recovery: Invalid selector/target/cache refuses; rebuild writes only derived cache/report output.
rows.view_or_authority: Report/SQLite are views; journal remains authority.
rows.disposition: Existing; freeze whether stale read is allowed while rebuild is pending.

rows.behavior: Permit explicit tracking without a proposal/assessment and preserve unresolved opportunity.
rows.consumer: application history/status, projection/report
rows.input_shape: Direct confirmed application event; optional docs; opportunity_ref independently validated when reader supplied.
rows.output_shape: Committed event; current/history status; opportunity_verified true/false or strict refusal.
rows.revision_and_provenance: Direct event evidence and operation receipt; proposal record is not required by writer.
rows.failure_and_recovery: No assessment is not itself an error; missing opportunity can be explicit unresolved or strict refusal based on caller mode.
rows.view_or_authority: Application event is authority; unresolved annotation is a projection property.
rows.disposition: Retain separation; later UI must not require or infer assessment.
